_comment: Control-maturity scoring, critical gaps, and framework readiness snapshots. Phase 8. Controls/Frameworks/FrameworkRequirements/ControlFrameworkMappings already live in 02-master-data.json — this file adds the per-property SCORING layer on top of that static master data. The critical-gap override math itself (MIN-of-dimension, capped-at-1 rollup) is in functions/shared/pure/maturity.ts and is NOT re-implemented here — this schema just persists its inputs and outputs.

tables.comment: One row per (control, property, dimension, assessment event) — append-only, never overwritten, so a control's maturity history is reconstructable. The SERVICE layer reads only the latest row per (control_id, property_id, dimension) when computing a rollup.

columns.comment: The row-scoping column — every query MUST run through propertyScopeClause().

Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 8 port. Null means a property-wide assessment; a value scopes the assessment to one department, mirroring apps/web/src/db/schema/framework.ts's controlAssessments.departmentId.

Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 8 port. Free-text reporting period, e.g. 'FY2026-Q2' — part of the (control, property, department, period, dimension) dedupe key used by the assessment-entry Server Action.
0-4. A score of <=1 on a life-safety-critical or legal control is a critical gap — see isCriticalGap() in maturity.ts.

Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 8 port. Persisted result of isCriticalGap() at the time this row was written, mirroring apps/web/src/db/schema/framework.ts's controlAssessments.isCriticalGap column (kept distinct from the separate CriticalGaps open/resolved tracking table below, which the apps/web Framework module does not yet write to — see data-store-schema/README.md).
E.g. 'Fire safety certificate expired 2026-06-01' — the human-readable reason behind a low score.

tables.comment: One open row per (control, property) currently in a critical-gap state — created when an assessment drops a life-safety-critical/legal control to <=1 on any dimension, resolved (resolved_at set, never deleted) when a later assessment clears it. Read directly by api-dashboard-summary's getCriticalGapsPreview().

Precomputed rollup per (framework, property-or-null-for-group-wide) — read by the framework readiness strip (docs/2026-07-zoho-catalyst-access-and-dashboard-model.md §4) instead of joining Controls/ControlAssessments/ControlFrameworkMappings live on every dashboard load. Recomputed whenever a ControlAssessment is recorded for a mapped control, or on a Cron schedule (Phase 13).

columns.comment: average_score after the critical-gap cap is applied — this is what's actually shown as readiness %.
